headline: 2 addresses confirmed on-chain (SKY token, Deployer EOA); ~15+ additional protocol contract addresses referenced in docs but not extractable due to JS-rendered navigator and inaccessible chainlog.

findings.text: D1: Etherscan search surfaced 'Sky: SKY Token' at 0x56072C95FAA701256059aa122697B133aDEd9279 and 'Sky: Deployer' at 0x4ec216c476175a236bd70026b984d4adeca0cfb8. The Etherscan label page at etherscan.io/accounts/label/sky was not fetchable (access blocked). MKR token (0x9f8f72aa9304c8b593d555f12ef6589cc3a579a2) also referenced.

D2: Official docs confirmed at https://developers.skyeco.com/. The Protocol Navigator at https://developers.skyeco.com/quick-start/protocol-navigator/ is the canonical deployed-contracts page but rendered entirely by JavaScript — the static HTML fetch returned no addresses. The chainlog at chainlog.sky.money was not reachable as it was not in an already-fetched URL.

D3: No audit_links were provided in the per-protocol context. No audit PDFs were discovered through the fetches performed this run. The Etherscan contract page for SKY token shows 'No Contract Security Audit Submitted'.

D4: GitHub organization https://github.com/sky-ecosystem was confirmed via the developer docs navigation (the GitHub link in the header). However, no specific deployment artifact files were fetched (no remaining fetch budget after docs and Etherscan). Repos referenced include sky-ecosystem/sky (Sky.sol, MkrSky.sol).

D5: Protocol.chains lists only Ethereum. No multi-chain enumeration required. The SKY token appears on HyperEVM (0x56072c95...) as a token holding in the Etherscan multichain portfolio view but that appears to be a non-primary deployment or token hold, not a protocol deployment.

D6: No factory addresses were confirmed with sufficient evidence to enumerate children. The Vat (core accounting), CDP Manager, and Join adapters mentioned in protocol docs act as factory-like registries, but no addresses were extracted for those contracts this run.

D7: Role taxonomy applied to the 2 confirmed addresses: SKY token (role: token, actor_class: unknown — no proxy/admin read performed), Sky Deployer EOA (role: other, actor_class: eoa). Docs reference additional roles: governance Chief, Pause, Spell, Vat (core), Pot (savings rate), Jug (rates), LockStake Engine, MkrSky Converter, USDS token, sUSDS token, stUSDS token, LitePSM, Smart Burn Engine — all unconfirmed addresses.

D8: Only 2 addresses placed in admin_addresses[] — both trace to fetched Etherscan URL. All other protocol contract addresses (USDS, sUSDS, stUSDS, MkrSky, LockStake, Chief, Pause, Vat, Pot, Jug, LitePSM, Smart Burn Engine) were referenced in docs but without extractable addresses, so they go to unknowns[].

rationale.verdict: Discovery incomplete: 2 addresses confirmed (SKY token and its deployer EOA) from Etherscan; the protocol's canonical deployed-contracts page (Protocol Navigator) is JS-rendered and yielded no addresses, and fetch budget was exhausted before reaching the chainlog or GitHub deployment artifacts. Approximately 15+ additional core and governance contract addresses are known to exist from the docs structure but their on-chain addresses remain undiscovered this run.

evidence.shows: SKY Governance Token contract at 0x56072C95FAA701256059aa122697B133aDEd9279 on Ethereum, labeled 'Sky: SKY Token' by Etherscan, deployed by 'Sky: Deployer' at 0x4ec216c476175a236bd70026b984d4adeca0cfb8. Contract source verified as Sky.sol with ward-based access control (rely/deny) and mint/burn functions.

Official Sky Protocol developer docs at developers.skyeco.com; Protocol Navigator page is the canonical deployed-contracts reference but is JS-rendered (no addresses in static HTML). GitHub org confirmed as https://github.com/sky-ecosystem.
SKY token docs confirming SKY Token and MkrSky Converter deployments on Ethereum, with deployment addresses linked to the Protocol Navigator. Codebase at github.com/sky-ecosystem/sky.

Sky.money feature descriptions: Sky Savings Rate (sUSDS), Sky Token Rewards (USDS staked for SKY), stUSDS module, SkyLink cross-chain rails, non-custodial smart contract architecture. Governance token SKY inherits from MKR.

protocol_metadata.about: Sky (formerly MakerDAO) is a decentralized stablecoin protocol on Ethereum that allows users to mint USDS (the successor to DAI) by locking crypto collateral into Collateralized Debt Positions. Users can also deposit USDS into the Sky Savings Rate module to earn yield as sUSDS, supply USDS to the stUSDS module to fund SKY-backed borrowing, and stake SKY tokens to participate in on-chain governance. The protocol is governed by SKY token holders who vote on protocol parameters and upgrades via an on-chain governance system inherited from MakerDAO.
